title: Your life isn't ruined. Here's how you *take it back.*

items.head: Quit porn
items.sub: Your drive was never gone. It was leaking.

items.head: Make your own money
items.sub: The first dollar you earn on your own hits different.

items.head: Pray or sit in silence daily
items.sub: 10 quiet minutes a morning trains you to sit with discomfort.

items.head: Train your body
items.sub: Men who lift walk into rooms differently.

items.head: Be kind, not soft
items.sub: Kindness with boundaries earns respect. Without them, you get used.

items.head: Delete one app
items.sub: The one that eats your mornings. Gone for 30 days.

head: Pick one. Start it *today.*
sub: Not all six. One. The rest gets easier after.
